core_obligations: (1) implies (2): if U is Spec of a field, the groupoid relation is transitive, so X = U amal ... is the quotient of a point by a transitive relation; X = Spec(k').

(2) implies (1): X = Spec(k') means the single point of X has residue field k'; the two points of U over k map to the same point of X, and decency of the presentation forces them equal, so U is a point with residue field k'.
difficulty_reason: A two-direction point-counting argument anchored on the quotient sheaf identification.
